QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Key to the Third Tower
QuestInfo.0: #p2161003# promised to stay behind to help others even after his brother was rescued. In order to defeat #o8210007#, you must have the #t4032834# that #b#p2161003##k carries.
QuestInfo.1: #p2161003# knows how to make the key, but he's asked you to bring the materials. Defeat the evil #r#o8210003##k and its kin to find enough of the #r#t4000627##k items to make the key.
QuestInfo.2: #p2161003# made you the #t4032833#. Use it to unlock the Roof of the Third Tower, and face the #o8210007#.

0.0: Hm? You want the #t4032834#? There's an extremely powerful monster in the Third Tower, #o8210007#. But, I'm sure you don't mind. You wouldn't want to go if you couldn't handle it!
0.1: I was in the Third Tower too, looking for my brother, so I know what kind of key to make. I'll need materials, of course. Whoever made these locks was big on variety, I guess. You can get the stuff I need from Bearwolves. Okay?

yes.0: Wow. You are just... Wow. Not that I'm, y'know, jealous or anything. I'm pretty useful, too...like when you need keys. Like now! If you clear out the #r#o8210003##k infestation and bring me #b50 #t4000627#s#k, I'll show you what I can do. Again.

no.0: Are Bearwolves too much for you to handle? I could try to steal from them with my Play Dead technique... Actually, that sounds too dangerous.

1.0: All right, you brought the #t4000627#s! Very impressive. Give me a moment, and I'll make your key.

yes.0: Here is the #t4032834# you've been waiting for. I hope you can defeat #o8210007#! That thing is horrible! Oh, and come back to see me if you happen to lose the key. I can always make more...with the right materials.

item.0: Still trying to fight back the #r#o8210003##k infestation? Still need #b50 #t4000627##k? I understand. Sometimes, even you struggle. I won't judge. Good luck!
